# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# --- r6: Ocarina of Time on a 6-core CPU (Ryzen 5 5500 + RX 6600) ---
# A trace in Hyrule Castle Town: the six guest cores ran 50-62% of the time, sleeping and waking
# ~600 times a second each and spending ~20% in Windows waits. These cut that overhead.
# Idle guest cores spin with PAUSE instead of yielding the SMT sibling (zortos293/Lichii#641).
EDEN_NX2_IDLE_PAUSE=1
# Scheduler interrupt path with a spin lock + atomic wait instead of mutex + condition variable.
EDEN_NX2_CORE_LOCK=1
# Current guest thread read from plain thread_locals.
EDEN_NX2_FAST_TLS=1
# Short spin before an address-arbiter wait sleeps.
EDEN_NX2_ARB_SPIN=8
# Ocarina's two main threads may run on any guest core instead of waiting for theirs.
EDEN_NX2_OOT_WIDE_AFFINITY=1
# Ocarina's frame-end poll sleeps 250 us instead of 1 ms.
EDEN_NX2_EXP24=3
# Ocarina's resource thread backs off instead of rescanning at once (built-in patch + its sleep).
EDEN_NX2_OOT_POLL_BACKOFF=1
EDEN_NX2_EXP25=1
# cLohan's Occlusion Off: no per-object occlusion queries, so no conditional-render readbacks.
EDEN_NX2_OCCLUSION_OFF=1
# Native uniform banks: compare only pages that may have changed (=1 keeps a once-a-frame check;
# zortos293/Lichii#909 found no write behind the tracker in Ocarina).
EDEN_NX2_EXP9=3
# Already on by default in r6, each with its own off switch:
#   EDEN_NX2_OOT_HOST_ZSTD=0       game's own zstd decoder instead of the host's
#   EDEN_NX2_OOT_FAST_LOOKUP_OFF=1 game's byte-by-byte strcmp in its index lookup
#   EDEN_NX2_INLINE_CNTPCT=0       counter reads through the host call
# To try: EDEN_NX2_PIN_THREADS=0 (the GPU threads stop reserving two whole cores).

# --- r6.1 ---
# Ocarina's name lookup (its hottest guest function in Castle Town) steps on the host; the
# game's code still runs the last steps of each search. EDEN_NX2_EXP50=1 turns it off live.
EDEN_NX2_OOT_NATIVE_LOOKUP=1
# On by default, each with its own off switch:
#   EDEN_NX2_AMD_APP_PIPELINE_CACHE=0  AMD: no vulkan_pipelines file (every boot builds all)
#   EDEN_NX2_VRAM_GUARD=0              no emergency purge when real VRAM use nears the budget
#   EDEN_NX2_VRAM_RESERVE_MIB=0        no VRAM kept back for the driver (descriptor pools)
#   EDEN_NX2_VMA_DUMP=0                no VRAM allocation map in the log folder near the budget

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
# Threads for each shader warm-up (compute, then graphics), 1 to 32. They run at low priority.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_THREADS=4
# The warm-up builds only while the game is paused or from Emulation > Prepare Shaders Now;
# =1 lets it build while the game runs too.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_WHILE_PLAYING=1
# Warm-up builds skip our vulkan_pipelines file (only the driver's cache keeps them); =1 adds
# them to it.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_APP_CACHE=1
